content:
Evelyn: Quick sync for AtlasPay POC starting Monday. Need three things: hosted API test keys for dev, a small Dedicated pool for perf runs, and VPC peering for staging. Security must-haves: BYOK (customer KMS), IP allowlist, and audit logs shipped to their S3. Also: they asked whether we provide credits or invoice for POCs.

Priya: Two quick clarifiers: expected peak RPS and average tokens per request? Which model family will they test and target region?

Evelyn: Peak ~1k RPS during a short ramp, avg 4-6k tokens per request (longform summarization). Model family: llm-2-xlarge. Region: us-west-2. POC length: 30 days.

Jordan: Provisioning checklist draft:
- Hosted API keys: Console > API Keys > Create -> name atlaspay_poc_{env}_{YYYYMMDD}. Create test keys with IP allowlist.
- Dedicated pool: open DP ticket with template below.
- VPC peering: request peering, provide route table changes and SG rules.
- BYOK: collect customer KMS ARN and key policy, request cross-account grant.
- Audit logs: enable delivery to customer S3 (need bucket ARN and SSE-KMS info).
- Dev smoke: give simple curl/locust snippets and perf guidance.

Jordan: Smoke curl (replace KEY):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"llm-2-xlarge","prompt":"hello"}'
```

Sam: Security quick answers for their questionnaire:
- BYOK: Supported via AWS KMS (customer-managed). We require KMS key ARN and a cross-account grant.
- Data at rest: model artifacts and KV caches encrypted at rest; recommend redaction of PII before storage.
- Audit logging: can stream request metadata and optionally responses to their S3 with SSE-KMS. Provide retention options.
- Pen tests: internal pen test policy exists; third-party pentest requires SOC/Legal signoff.
- IP allowlist vs VPC: we can provide static egress IPs for hosted keys or full isolation via VPC peering.

Sam: Note: get AtlasPay legal to sign the BYOK one-pager (minimal DTA) before we configure cross-account grants.

Marta: Pricing & credits guidance: typical small Dedicated POC (2x A10G-equivalent GPUs) list ~ $3,500/month. For POCs we usually offer $10k platform credits + one complimentary month of Dedicated under our enterprise eval program. For committed reserved capacity we require a minimum 3-month commit for discounts.

deploy-bot: Created ticket DP-4621 for Dedicated pool request: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/DP-4621

Jordan: Dedicated pool request template to paste in DP ticket:
- customer: AtlasPay
- environment: poc-staging
- model_family: llm-2-xlarge
- gpu_count: 2
- gpu_type: A10G-equivalent
- region: us-west-2
- start_date: 2026-04-06
- duration_days: 30
- network: VPC peering (customer CIDR + AWS account id required)
- kms_arn: <customer-provided>
- audit_s3_arn: <customer-provided>
- contact_owner: Priya

Priya: I'll own onboarding runbook. I'll send calendar invite with checklist items: create keys, DP ticket, collect KMS ARN and S3, provide test corpus and perf script.

Evelyn: Sales asked for a short perf runbook so AtlasPay can try to reproduce ~1k RPS locally: include a Locust/JMeter example and a token budget estimate.

Jordan: Note on tokens/concurrency: 1k RPS * 5k tokens = 5M tokens per second (this is unrealistic for a single small pool). We'll recommend bursty patterns, batching, and lower concurrency for realistic perf tests. I'll add suggested concurrency, batch_size, and sample Locust file to DP ticket.

Marta: Finance note: if they consume credits early, billing should notify them 3 days prior. I'll add billing alert step and contact for ad-hoc invoice.

Evelyn: Owners: Priya (onboarding lead), Jordan (infra/provisioning), Sam (security QA), Marta (billing/pricing). We'll update the sales HT to AtlasPay with the expected timeline.

Priya: Sending invite now :calendar:

Evelyn: Thanks all :thumbsup:
